Be essential at Cars Commerce

At Cars Commerce, we’re fanatical about simplifying everything about car buying and selling. We do right by our customers and consumers to better connect the industry with simplified and tierless technology to enhance, measure and drive local automotive retail. Whether through our No.1 most recognized marketplace, Cars.com, our industry-leading digital experience, Dealer Inspire, our trade and appraisal technology, AccuTrade, or our new Cars Commerce Media Network, Cars Commerce is essential for success in the automotive industry.

No one ever travels alone here: at its core, Cars Commerce is collaboration. In fact, it’s built into the very fabric of our shared values. We like to say we Rise Together – putting people at the center of what we do, from consumer to customer to community. Life at Cars Commerce makes it easy when we share the ethos to be Open to All, encouraging open-minded communication because we know diverse thinking yields better outcomes. But critical to our success is Caring to Challenge and Taking Ownership, fueling a competitive spirit in a respectful environment where we think about tomorrow but act today. At our foundation, we have integrity, Doing the Right Thing, even when it’s hard. It’s our shared commitment to these values that makes Cars Commerce a place where growth becomes not only possible, but downright unavoidable.

But don’t take our word for it. As a U.S. News & World Report Best Company to Work For in 2024, we're obsessive about the employee experience. We are among the top 20% being declared “Best” of our industry based on six critical factors that are important to employee wellbeing, like quality of pay, benefits, work life balance and more.

About the Team:

Data Science @ Cars Commerce is a group of collaborative and humble individuals from diverse backgrounds. We are actively involved in the open source community and regularly participate in Data Science events. We learn from each other through regular algorithmic/code review sessions and stay connected through coffee chats in this remote world.

About the Projects:

We deliver scalable ML products that are served to millions of users through our website and mobile app. Search, Recommendation Systems, Pricing and Churn are some of the example projects that we actively work on. Right from the start, each team member will own a product(s) and as the time progresses, you will gain exposure to working on diverse areas of ML. The team maintains a healthy balance between research projects and immediate deliverables.

On a typical week you will:
• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define, design, build and deploy machine learning models and frame AB tests
• Understand business impact of models and monitor model performances to make sure model outputs are of good quality at all times
• Apply robust and maintainable coding practices to ensure model outputs are provided reliably and efficiently at all times
• Work with business partners to identify business opportunities and trends
• Communicate modeling methodologies and analytical findings to business stakeholders
• Stay up-to-date with latest technology trends and publish research articles on science and innovations

Requirements:
• 2+ years professional experience in developing machine learning models with a MS in machine-learning, applied mathematics or related quantitative fields
• Understanding of supervised, unsupervised machine learning and deep learning concepts
• Exposure to and understanding of GenAI concepts, models and tooling preferred
• Experience with entire pipeline of deploying machine learning algorithms including development, validation, implementation and production launch
• Strong coding skills in Python/PySpark and good at writing SQL queries
• Understanding of AWS ecosystem
• Be flexible in working on diverse problems instead of focusing on a particular ML area like Image Recognition, Natural Language Processing etc.
• Understanding of coding best practices and familiar with version control tools

Preferred:
• PhD/Masters in statistics, econometrics, machine-learning, applied mathematics or related quantitative field
• Experience in building end to end Machine Learning systems

AgencyMarketingStatement

The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), a major operating component of the Department of Health and Human Services, is the nation's leading science-based, data-driven, service organization that protects the public's health. For more than 75 years, we have put science into action to help children stay healthy so they can grow and learn; to help families, businesses, and communities fight disease and stay strong; and to protect the public's health. In addition, CDC also has a critical preparedness and response mission: we protect the American people from health threats, research emerging diseases, and mobilize public health programs with domestic and international partners. CDC's 24/7 Emergency Operations Center (EOC) unites highly trained experts, well established processes, and state-of-the-art technology to coordinate resources and information as CDC responds to emergencies worldwide. Every CDC employee has a role in supporting public health emergency management, whether through temporary assignments to emergency responses or sustaining other CDC programs and activities while colleagues respond. CDC offers exciting and dynamic opportunities in Public Health with global impact. Examine how you can use your talent, training, and passion to help CDC continue as the world's premier public health organization. Please visit www.cdc.gov for more information.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Summary:

In this role, your primary responsibility will be to partner with key stakeholders and program managers, and lead the development of analytics programs to support and enable the continued growth critical to Meta's Data Center E2E lifecycle. As we plan to grow our Data Center footprint, we need to leverage data to drive decisions and introduce automation, predictability & optimization to allow us to operate efficiently and reliably at scale. You will be responsible for creating end-to-end analytics programs, from data sourcing to surfacing insights and driving action, for various aspects of Meta's global data center operations. You will also help translate business problems to data science problems, identify solutions and efficiency opportunities. You will be expected to use data to provide meaningful recommendations and actionable strategies to key stakeholders, and develop best practices, including streamlining of data sources and related programmatic initiatives.The ideal candidate will have a passion for working in white space and creating impact from the ground up in a fast-paced environment. Additionally, you will have a proven track record of thought leadership and impact in developing similar analytics and metrics-based programs. This position is part of the Infrastructure Data Centers organization.

Required Skills:

Data Scientist, Analytics Responsibilities:

job_description:
We're hiring a founding data scientist (NYC based or hybrid) to be a part of our early story: you'll build our data operations and join our mission of bringing energy retrofits to renters.

   Fram Energy brings the energy transition to rental tenants, beginning with the multifamily segment. We're a VC-backed company building the data platform and fintech infrastructure to de-risk energy retrofits for property owners- making sustainable rental homes a logical, profitable decision. If you want to lead data operations in a great team on the intersection of climate, proptech and fintech, read on!

Get in touch at jobs@framenergy.com →

On Fram Energy

Rental homes are lagging behind in the energy transition. As you are (hopefully) into data: renters have 20% higher energy cost than owner occupied homes, adoption of heat pumps is 4x lower in rental homes and less than 1% of residential rooftop solar is installed on rental homes. This is a climate problem, an equity problem and a missed economical opportunity.

Fram Energy is bringing energy retrofits to the massive, underserved rental market. We identified the key barriers that are keeping energy retrofits from being deployed and developed a business model that tackles them. Our platform de-risks investments in energy retrofits and realigns incentives. For property owners, we open up a new income stream whilst simultaneously addressing net zero goals. For renters, we lower energy bills and increase comfort and quality of life. For the planet, we unlock gigaton scale emissions reduction.

Fram Energy is wrapping up a $1.5M pre-seed fundraising round led by Precursor Ventures, with participation from strong climate, fintech and proptech investors. Our first pilot projects will be deployed this fall.

Fram Energy was founded in 2023 by Charlotte Meerstadt. We are building a purpose-driven, highly functioning and joyful team to deliver on all these promises. Read more about our culture here.

What you'll do (impact)

This is a really cool role, in which you’ll be a meaningful part of Fram’s early story. You will lead the development and implementation of our data operations. In order to serve our customers and price our services correctly, Fram Energy has to get really good at predicting energy savings for multifamily properties. The high quality database and model that you’ll build could power gigaton-scale emissions reduction, reduce renters’ energy bills by billions of dollars and boost net operating income for property owners. Besides that, it’s a rewarding technical challenge.
You’ll drive Fram Energy’s success by:
• Building a stellar database.
You will take the lead in building the largest and best database for multifamily building energy efficiency. At first this will primarily consist of third-party data, whilst you work with our business development and software teams to start taking in first-party data. You will structure and design the database to be scalable, versatile and robust.
• Creating a model that predicts energy savings from retrofits really well.
You will use the data that you’ve aggregated to develop a model that predicts performance of energy retrofits for multifamily with high accuracy. You’ll have considerable freedom to design and implement this model.
• Integrating with Fram’s broader software.
Your work will be plugged into different parts of our software stack, so as you work to build the best possible data operation, you will also be aligning data intake and outputs with the software and business teams.
• Solving interesting technical problems.
This job has a lot of room for creativity and experimentation. We’re seeking to build something groundbreaking and acing our data operation is key to achieving it. You’ll encounter all kinds of challenging and one-of-a-kind technical problems, and we’ll give you freedom to play around in order to find the best solution.
• Hustling as part of our founding team!
In this early stage, everyone will be helping out beyond their job description, and every person on the founding team has the chance to grow their skills in directions they find meaningful.

What we're looking for (attributes & qualifications)
Attributes
• Curious, self-directed fast learner.
We believe in giving all team members abundant trust and ownership. You thrive when you are given freedom to strategize, execute and troubleshoot in your own domain whilst staying plugged in to adjacent work streams and aligned with the growth of the company as a whole. You are self-motivated and practical.
• Collaborative.
It energizes you to work closely with our software and business development teams, with whom your domain will have significant interfaces. You are a strong communicator and you’re a reliable team member to work with.
• You’re really good at what you do.
You have a track record of excellence in developing new insights, products or services through data operations. You have deep understanding of and demonstrable previous success in algorithms, data structures, performance optimization techniques, relational databases.
• Kind & low ego.
We see kindness as a form of excellence. Fram’s values resonate with you and you are excited to add your own magic to the mix.
• Purpose fit.
You’re passionate about Fram’s mission to decarbonize rental homes!

Qualifications

We're looking to build confidence that you can lead the development of our data operations.
• Preferred work experience.
3+ years of experience building scalable databases and predictive models in a team setting.
• Relevant software skills.
Proficient with data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python specifically the pandas, numpy and tensorflow libraries), and statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R).
• Preferred sector fit.
Prior experience in building energy efficiency modeling would be a big plus.
• Education.
B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in data science, computer science, operations research, or related field.
• Geographic fit.
The position is located in New York City, working in-person at least 3 days a week. We're open to helping with relocation.

What we offer

  ‍  ‍  ‍   Find your Framily

We are building a community of kind + exceptional humans. We are big believers in finding joy in your job (see our values) and we structure our way of working to maximize good days. We are excited to build out our team activities- the first dinner is on the calendar and we’ll plan outings and an offsite once we have filled our open roles.

   One heck of a ride

You will be one of the very first team members on an ambitious and important mission. We can say from experience that the purpose, personal development, opportunities for growth, freedom and creativity that come with that are unlike anything you will find in a larger organization. Are you ready to move your work life from black and white to technicolor?

   A leadership team that cares deeply about your growth and fulfilment

At Fram, we believe that unlocking your superpowers is our most important lever to build a big and impactful company. Fram’s internal processes are designed very thoughtfully to enable you to thrive. Our founder, Charlotte, followed a coaching training program at Stanford and has done >100 hours of coaching, so she will bring that lens to make Fram a meaningful part of your career journey.

   Attractive compensation and benefits

We will treat you well. If there are any other benefits that are important to you, we'd like to hear.
• Competitive salary and equity — Salary will depend on your level of experience. We’ll give you multiple offer options based on your desire for ownership.
• We invest in you — Fram Energy uplifts your life and career through budgets for coaching, professional development and wellbeing.
• Competitive benefits — Fram Energy’s offer will come with attractive health insurance, 401k, PTO, parental policies and other benefits.
• Hybrid-friendly culture with in-person option — get the best of both worlds by working in your most comfortable environment, as well as having regular highly collaborative sessions in our New York City office.
• Flexible hardware and software access — We’ll work together to make sure you have access to the tools you need to excel at this job.

How to Apply

Interested to apply? We can’t wait to meet you! Hit the button below to apply via Ashby. If you have questions about the role, please direct them to jobs@framenergy.com.
• To put us in the best position to evaluate your candidacy, be sure to tailor your application to the “What we’re looking for” section above.
• Please include links or descriptions of projects that best showcase the relevant things you've built and done.
• The interview process consists of several informal and formal interviews, a work sample and reference checks. You will be asked to sign an NDA.
• Diversity and inclusion matter to us. If you are a member of an underrepresented group in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply. We take your context into account in our evaluation of candidates.

Fired up to work for Fram but not a fit for this role? If you resonate with our mission and think your profile would be a great fit for other opportunities, send an email to jobs@framenergy.com and pass along any information you believe is relevant.

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation- helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while crafting a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Key Responsibilities: Overall responsibility - The person in this job role would be using machine learning & data science techniques to help in development of analytics based-solutions by making sense of messy datasets, using variety of data sources for predictive modeling, perform ad hoc data analysis thereby contributing towards informed decision making. Working with the business partners/team to understand the requirements & define the problem/question. Acquire, join & mine data from different data sources (Oracle DB, Tableau Data Source, Salesforce) using a range of data science tools (Alteryx, Tableau Prep, SQL, Python).

Iterative data exploration/visualization & statistical analysis to identify plausible correlations in the data. Participate in brainstorming sessions with the business partners/team to align the observed correlations in the data with established business processes. Identify & discuss the algorithm type (machine learning problem type), model evaluation KPIs with the team.

Perform feasibility checks to understand if the problem can be solved using machine learning. Building & testing predictive models. Understanding bias-variance tradeoff, cases of over-fitting/under-fitting & resolution techniques.

Taking measures to follow ML best practices. Discussion & explanation of performance KPIs to stakeholders to ensure interpretation in business context. Model deployment & performance validation/monitoring at regular intervals.

Iterative hyper-parameter tuning/data mining/feature engineering to improve model performance while seeking feedback from the stakeholders to incorporate business knowledge back to the model. Work with the team to document processes & requirements in a way that can be understood by all business partners. Qualifications: A master's degree in a quantitative discipline or any of the following fields of study (data science & business analytics, statistics, economics, operations research).

Minimum 3 years of both technical & work experience required. Working knowledge on various data science tools (Python, SQL, Alteryx, Tableau Desktop, Tableau Prep) to capture & mine data (both structured & unstructured) from variety of data sources (Salesforce, Oracle Db, Tableau data source). Data visualization skills for ad hoc & exploratory data analysis.

Ability to proactively brainstorm ideas with the team, report data findings & observations to the stakeholders. Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?

PMI maintains the largest global community of project professionals and seeks frequent forms of engagement with the community members via its 300+ local chapters.

You will be responsible for leading data science strategy and execution. Guiding and mentoring 1-2 data scientists. Responsible for owning and driving end-to-end delivery of machine-learning-based solutions to solve business problems in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.

• Drive end-to-end delivery of machine-learning models.

About RevOpsforce:

RevOpsforce is a revenue operations workforce management firm supporting clients to unlock revenue potential through solutions that better align people, processes, data, and technology. We empower organizations with cutting-edge revenue operations management systems, seamlessly aligning sales, marketing, and customer service teams to unlock increased revenue and elevate overall company value. Whether their focus is on enhancing existing revenue generation, streamlining operations through specialized services, refining data management, or optimizing marketing and sales processes, we are their partner for agile and strategic growth support.

Our Expert Network is composed of the highest skilled and certified professionals in revenue operations. We leverage this network to solve our clients’ most complex operational challenges.

Type: Contract - Expert Network

Job Description:

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist who will lead our data-driven initiatives to extract valuable insights, patterns, and trends from complex datasets, empowering our clients to make informed strategic decisions. You will leverage your deep analytical skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and employ advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to uncover actionable insights that drive revenue growth.

Responsibilities:
• Lead end-to-end data science projects, from defining objectives to data collection, exploration, model development, validation, and deployment.
• Collaborate with domain experts and business stakeholders to understand revenue-related challenges and formulate data-driven solutions.
• Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to analyze large datasets, identifying patterns and trends that impact revenue generation and operations.
• Develop predictive and prescriptive models to forecast customer behavior, optimize pricing strategies, and enhance customer engagement.
• Design and implement A/B tests and experiments to validate hypotheses and quantify the impact of strategic changes.
• Clean, preprocess, and manipulate data to ensure data quality and suitability for analysis and modeling.
• Visualize findings and insights to effectively communicate results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Mentor junior data scientists, providing technical guidance, fostering skill development, and promoting a culture of innovation.

Qualifications:
• Master's or Ph.D. degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
• 7+ years of hands-on experience in data science, working with large datasets, and applying advanced analytical methods.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, along with experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn).
• Extensive experience with machine learning algorithms, model development, and evaluation techniques.
• Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experiment design.
• Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, or similar libraries.
• Experience with SQL and relational databases for data extraction and manipulation.
• Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions.
• Effective communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
• Demonstrated experience in leading data science projects and mentoring junior team members.
• Published research, relevant certifications, and contributions to the data science community are advantageous.

The Expert Network at RevOpsforce

The new world of work is empowering, where the freedom to work on your terms has never been more attainable. Embrace the flexibility to choose where, when, and how you work, all within the evolving landscape of the gig economy and dynamic employee-employer relationships. At RevOpsforce, our commitment lies in crafting agile working arrangements that open doors to a wealth of contract opportunities, now easily accessible to you.

What to Expect:

Project-based work: Apply your RevOps expertise to various client projects, with engagements lasting multiple months.

Flexible schedule: Maintain a healthy work-life balance with a schedule ranging from 10-40 hours per week. Projects may not be consecutive, allowing you to structure your workweek as needed. This provides you with the freedom to pursue other interests or professional development during gaps between projects.

Continuous learning: Network with other top-tier RevOps professionals, fostering a collaborative environment for skill development and staying current in the industry.

Who We're Looking For:

The Expert Network seeks passionate RevOps professionals with:
• Strong experience in revenue operations functions
• A desire to contribute to impactful projects
• A commitment to staying current in the RevOps landscape
• A preference for a self-directed, project-based work style

Join the Movement:

The RevOpsforce Expert Network allows you to:
• Contribute to the success of our clients through strategic RevOps initiatives.
• Maintain work-life balance with a flexible schedule you control.
• Continuously develop your skills through collaboration with a skilled community.
• Be at the forefront of the evolving RevOps landscape.
• Curate your workload: The project-based nature, with potential gaps between engagements, allows you to manage your time effectively and pursue other opportunities or personal interests.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Visit us at www.revopsforce.com

Summary:

In this role, your primary responsibility will be to partner with key stakeholders and program managers, and lead the development of analytics programs to support and enable the continued growth critical to Meta's Data Center E2E lifecycle. As we plan to grow our Data Center footprint, we need to leverage data to drive decisions and introduce automation, predictability & optimization to allow us to operate efficiently and reliably at scale. You will be responsible for creating end-to-end analytics programs, from data sourcing to surfacing insights and driving action, for various aspects of Meta's global data center operations. You will also help translate business problems to data science problems, identify solutions and efficiency opportunities. You will be expected to use data to provide meaningful recommendations and actionable strategies to key stakeholders, and develop best practices, including streamlining of data sources and related programmatic initiatives.The ideal candidate will have a passion for working in white space and creating impact from the ground up in a fast-paced environment. Additionally, you will have a proven track record of thought leadership and impact in developing similar analytics and metrics-based programs. This position is part of the Infrastructure Data Centers organization.

Required Skills:

Data Scientist, Analytics Responsibilities:

1. Leverage data and business principles to drive large scale Meta’s Data Center programs.

2. Define and develop the program for metrics creation, data collection, modeling, and reporting the operational performance of Meta’s data centers.

3. Collaborate with cross-functional data and business teams to define problem statements, access and manipulate data, build analytical models, explain data-gathering requirements, deliver analytics insights, and make recommendations.

4. Define, compute, track, and continuously validate business metrics with descriptive and predictive analytics. Leverage tools like Python, SQL, R, and Tableau for analytics.

5. Design & Implement statistical models such as Hypothesis testing, Forecasting, statistical process control and simulation to evaluate critical business decisions and influence our Data Center planning & Operations.

6. Identify gaps in the operational processes, build analytical models for finding insights and helping in driving decisions across different org leadership.

7. Provide mentorship to other members of the team on development of best practices for design and implementation of cutting-edge analytics insights.

8. Lead and support various ad hoc projects, as needed, in support of Data Center strategy.

As a Data Scientist at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Oculus).

By applying your technical skills, analytical mindset, and product intuition to one of the richest data sets in the world, you will help define the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses around the world.

You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, Data Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance and others.

You will use data and analysis to identify and solve product development’s biggest challenges. You will influence product strategy and investment decisions with data, be focused on impact, and collaborate with other teams.

By joining Meta, you will become part of a world-class analytics community dedicated to skill development and career growth in analytics and beyond.

Summary:

In this role, your primary responsibility will be to partner with key stakeholders and program managers, and lead the development of analytics programs to support and enable the continued growth critical to Meta's Data Center E2E lifecycle. As we plan to grow our Data Center footprint, we need to leverage data to drive decisions and introduce automation, predictability & optimization to allow us to operate efficiently and reliably at scale. You will be responsible for creating end-to-end analytics programs, from data sourcing to surfacing insights and driving action, for various aspects of Meta's global data center operations. You will also help translate business problems to data science problems, identify solutions and efficiency opportunities. You will be expected to use data to provide meaningful recommendations and actionable strategies to key stakeholders, and develop best practices, including streamlining of data sources and related programmatic initiatives.The ideal candidate will have a passion for working in white space and creating impact from the ground up in a fast-paced environment. Additionally, you will have a proven track record of thought leadership and impact in developing similar analytics and metrics-based programs. This position is part of the Infrastructure Data Centers organization.

Required Skills:

Data Scientist, Analytics Responsibilities:

1. Leverage data and business principles to drive large scale Meta’s Data Center programs.

2. Define and develop the program for metrics creation, data collection, modeling, and reporting the operational performance of Meta’s data centers.

3. Collaborate with cross-functional data and business teams to define problem statements, access and manipulate data, build analytical models, explain data-gathering requirements, deliver analytics insights, and make recommendations.

4. Define, compute, track, and continuously validate business metrics with descriptive and predictive analytics. Leverage tools like Python, SQL, R, and Tableau for analytics.

5. Design & Implement statistical models such as Hypothesis testing, Forecasting, statistical process control and simulation to evaluate critical business decisions and influence our Data Center planning & Operations.

6. Identify gaps in the operational processes, build analytical models for finding insights and helping in driving decisions across different org leadership.

7. Provide mentorship to other members of the team on development of best practices for design and implementation of cutting-edge analytics insights.

8. Lead and support various ad hoc projects, as needed, in support of Data Center strategy.
